description.p: binscatter counts points in two-dimensional bins and displays the counts as a native binscatter chart object.
Values, XBinEdges, and YBinEdges are computed read-only properties.
When the axes are zoomed, the chart recomputes smaller bins so the visible region keeps approximately the requested bin density.
See binscatter properties for the complete property list.

example_item.example_item_description: Inspect computed bin values and edges.
